connectionFailed.title: Can't Connect to the Server
connectionFailed.hint: The server may be restarting or the network may be down. Try again in a moment.

projectUnavailable.title: Can't Open the Project
projectUnavailable.hint: The project may not be registered, its folder may be unavailable, or the server may be stopping. Retry, or continue without a project.

incompatible.title: Page and Server Versions Don't Match
incompatible.hint: Reload the page to load the version that matches the server.

startupFailed.title: The Workbench Failed to Start
startupFailed.hint: Reload the page to try again. If it still fails, check the server log.

serverRestarted.title: The Server Restarted
serverRestarted.hint: Reload the page to reconnect to the server.

projectGone.title: The Project Was Closed
projectGone.hint: The project was closed on the server (no window used it for a while, it exited unexpectedly, or the server restarted). Reload the page to reopen it, or continue without a project.

rescued.title: Unsaved Changes
rescued.hint: Copy the text below before reloading. It won't be kept after the reload.

offline.banner: The connection to the server was lost. Reconnecting…

errors.target-gone: The target window or instance is gone
errors.not-provided: The server does not provide this feature
errors.version-changed: The page and the server are out of sync; reload the page
errors.timeout: The server did not answer in time
errors.unknown-outcome: It is unknown whether the operation completed; check before retrying
errors.provider-error: The server failed while handling the request

layer.title: Closing…
layer.hint: Checking whether this window can be closed.

participantFailed.title: A check before closing failed
participantFailed.body: Something went wrong while checking for unsaved content. Closing anyway may lose unsaved changes.

rescuedLost.title: This text will be lost
rescuedLost.body: These files have unsaved text that can't be recovered after the window closes:

work.title: Closing will stop the NeuroBook service
work.body: The following work will be interrupted:
work.uncertain: Couldn't confirm whether any work is running.

available.title: NeuroBook {{version}} is available
available.message: Download it now; it installs the next time you open NeuroBook.

notifyOnly.title: NeuroBook {{version}} is available to download
notifyOnly.message: This copy of NeuroBook does not update itself. Get the new version from the download page.
notifyOnly.envRootMessage: NeuroBook was opened with NBOOK_STATE_ROOT set, so it does not update itself. Open it without that environment variable to update automatically.

downloading.title: Downloading NeuroBook {{version}}
downloading.message: You can close this notification; the download continues.

downloadFailed.title: The update did not download
downloadFailed.message: NeuroBook {{version}} did not finish downloading. You can try again.

downloaded.title: NeuroBook {{version}} is downloaded
downloaded.message: It installs the next time you open NeuroBook.

updated.title: Updated to NeuroBook {{version}}
updated.message: You are now using the new version.

updateFailed.title: The update did not finish
updateFailed.message: NeuroBook {{version}} was not installed, so you are still using the previous version. You will be told again when a new version is found.
